scope: Barcode format/checksum audit of every variant whose Shopify parent status is ACTIVE; no product bodies, images, supplier/customer data, secrets or external mutations.

snapshotWindow.note: Sequential paginated read, not an atomic database snapshot. Root-owned correction activity on two products is separate. Every page timestamp is preserved; this snapshot still contains those43 checksum-failing values.

summary.internalCodeOrigin: UNKNOWN; no nonnumeric/internal-label-formatted values were observed. Numeric invalid checksums do not prove the origin of the values.
summary.manufacturerVerificationStatus: NOT RUN; zero denotes no evidence verified in this audit, not a claim that no genuine GTINs exist.

method.filter: product_status:active, additionally require returned product.status === ACTIVE before classification
method.empty: null, undefined or whitespace-only; raw values preserved. All observed empties were null.
method.format: Only ASCII digits with exact raw lengths8,12,13,14 enter checksum validation; no trimming or silent coercion of nonempty input.
method.checksum: GS1 modulo10: omit final digit; weight remaining digits3,1 alternately from the right; expected final digit=(10-weightedSum%10)%10.
method.positiveControlProvenance: GS1's official6291041500213 example uses sum57 and check digit3. Other listed format controls are synthetic algorithm checks, not claims of licensed identifiers.
method.limits: Checksum success establishes arithmetic integrity only. Manufacturer allocation, ownership and product match are unverified. Do not invent replacement check digits, infer identifier_exists=false, mark products custom, or infer identifiers do not exist.

rootOwnedTwoProductsChecksumFailures.limit: 43 variants across the exact two root-owned products; preserve root's current correction and do not duplicate it.

remainingChecksumFailures.limit: 1065 variants across68 other ACTIVE products. Numeric-format validity does not make these usable GTINs. Root owns reviewed barcode-only containment or verified replacement using fresh before-state and rollback; no mutations by this agent.

nonGtinFormatLength.limit: No cohort observed; do not reinterpret numeric checksum failures as harmless text labels.

emptyBarcode.limit: 3712 variants across170 products need identifier availability/provenance investigation. Empty Shopify fields do not prove GTINs do not exist.

checksumValidUnverified.limit: 125 variants across57 products require manufacturer/assignment/product-match evidence before treating values as verified identifiers; do not auto-clear or relabel as valid.

nextAction: Root integrates this exact read-only cohort into current identifier containment and provenance work; finish existing two-product repair first, then assess the separate1065-variant cohort with independent review.

validationReadbackDesign.expectedParentIds: Exactly baseline240 productIds with parent.status ACTIVE

pagination.method: Start after=null; pass prior endCursor to next call until hasNextPage=false. Preserve each page. At cap or unexpected counts/IDs, report FAILED/DRIFT; never call a truncated scan complete.

validationReadbackDesign.baseline: This JSON's immutable before-correction rows; no checksum-count rewrite after later corrections.
validationReadbackDesign.executionManifest: Root supplies exact unique variant IDs actually cleared, each required to belong to this snapshot's BAD_CHECKSUM cohort; do not use proposed IDs or assume all proposed writes succeeded.
fullComparison: Scan every ACTIVE-parent variant, not only canaries or edited variants.
Require exact variant/parent ID sets and counts; duplicates, missing IDs, extra IDs or status drift fail.
For each actually cleared ID, require returned barcode null or empty string and report the persisted representation. Whitespace-only values do not satisfy a clear.

For every other variant, require barcode exactly equals baseline raw value; preserve all125 checksum-passing values and3712 baseline nulls unless a separate root manifest authorizes a different effect.
Run both independent GS1 implementations and the same15 controls over the complete result.

conditionalCounts.variable: k = successfully executed unique clear IDs from the1108 bad-checksum baseline
conditionalCounts.interpretation: EXPECTED conditional arithmetic, not fresh after-state evidence.

validationReadbackDesign.limits: Validates all queried identifiers and parent identity/status independently of canary samples. Does not verify manufacturer allocation, identifiers_exist, Merchant ingestion, prices, other Shopify fields or actual profitability. No query execution/rescan or mutation performed for this design.
